title: Simplify and support your TorchServe workloads using Ray Serve Deep Learning Containers
content: TorchServe is no longer maintained, leaving teams to own the entire GPU inference stack. The AWS Ray Serve Deep Learning Container is a supported, pre-tested container with the framework, GPU drivers, and serving layer already assembled. This post walks through deploying a vision-language model on Amazon EKS using the Ray Serve DLC on a single GPU node. Interested in cloud offerings specifically available in the China region? title: Automate user-level custom permissions for Amazon Quick
content: Amazon Quick custom permissions let you enforce least-privilege access by toggling features per user. This post walks through four patterns to automate custom permissions across the user lifecycle: a RegisterUser API parameter, account and role defaults, event-driven Amazon EventBridge and AWS Lambda automation, and a retroactive batch update script. title: 中国独生子女更倾向于与其他独生子女结婚
content: Research indicates a mating preference in China where only children are significantly more likely to marry other only children. This demographic pattern reflects social and familial dynamics unique to the one-child policy generation, where individuals with similar backgrounds tend to form partnerships. The study highlights that shared experiences of being the sole child influence compatibility and selection criteria in the marriage market.
